_comment: Velvet mesquite (Prosopis velutina, syn. Neltuma velutina) game stats for the Sonoran content pack. Botany/ecology from: USDA FS FEIS Prosopis velutina (Uchytil 1990, https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/provel/all.html); UA Campus Arboretum taxon page (https://apps.cals.arizona.edu/arboretum/taxon.aspx?id=235); Garden Oracle growing notes (pH 6.6-8.5, full sun, no nitrogen fertilizer). Game cost/benefit numbers are PROPOSED values for the store/tuning schema (see tuning note) - this file does not overwrite any tuning.json; values are chosen to be consistent with the tuning schema proposed in feat/4 (money, manhours, water_need_gal_per_mo / water_gal_per_mo in gallons, soil/wind effects).
soil: well-draining, pH 6.6-8.5; no nitrogen fertilizer needed
establishment: Propagated by seed; needs deep supplemental watering in first 1-2 summers, then minimal once established (taproot reaches groundwater).
ecology: Legume nitrogen fixer: enriches soil via root bacteria, benefits surrounding plants.
Deep taproot accesses groundwater; 'fertility island' under canopy lifts soil organic matter.
Bosque dominant along washes; scattered individuals on bajadas/desert grassland.
Resprouts from underground buds after fire/top-kill; mature trees rarely killed by fire.

game_stats_proposed._tuning_note: Proposed values aligned with the feat/4 store tuning schema (data/tuning.json item id 'mesquite', per-tree): cost_usd, build_manhours, upkeep_manhours_per_mo, upkeep_usd_per_mo, water_need_gal_per_mo, yield_usd_per_mo from yield_start_month. Verify these against data/tuning.json once feat/4 lands; extra ecology-driven modifiers including survival are namespaced under 'extensions' and this file does not alter tuning.json.

survival.plant_in_foresummer_penalty: Apr-Jun planting: survival x0.6 unless irrigated at establishment rate
survival.drought_tolerance: high once established; seedlings need monsoon/winter rains or irrigation
survival.month_rule: Every month is defined: Jul-Mar plant at standard/optimal survival (winter rains Dec-Mar bank soil moisture); Apr-Jun plant at x0.6 survival unless irrigated at establishment rate.

sources: USDA Forest Service FEIS - Prosopis velutina (https://www.fs.usda.gov/database/feis/plants/tree/provel/all.html)
UA Campus Arboretum - Prosopis velutina taxon (https://apps.cals.arizona.edu/arboretum/taxon.aspx?id=235)
Garden Oracle - Velvet mesquite growing notes (pH 6.6-8.5, full sun, no nitrogen fertilizer)
NWS Tucson normals for planting-season rainfall context (https://www.weather.gov/twc/TucsonMonthlyNormalExtremes)
